test_title: PYST 6: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 24 March 2021 (Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All friends are relatives.

No relatives are arrogant.

Conclusions:

I. No friend is arrogant.

II. Some friends are arrogant.

III. Some relatives are friends

options.text: Only Conclusion I and II follow.
Either Conclusion I or II follows.
Either Conclusion I or III follows.
Only Conclusion I and III follow.

solution:
The least possible venn diagram is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5ccfedb3fb7bd8bad7d7599f4b9f21301a5678c08c41120ca529a3fde9c9071.png] 

I. No friend is arrogant → True (Definitely true)

II. Some friends are arrogant → False (Definitely false)

III. Some relatives are friends → True (Definitely true)

Hence, Only Conclusion I and III follow.
